Nudist_0.Name: Nudist
Nudist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} genießt das Gefühl der Freiheit, das {PAWN_pronoun} hat, wenn {PAWN_pronoun} unbekleidet ist. {PAWN_pronoun} kann zwar Kleidung tragen, aber ist ohne sie glücklicher.

Bloodlust_0.Name: Blutrünstig
Bloodlust_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} bekommt einen Kick, wenn {PAWN_pronoun} jemanden verletzt, und stört sich nicht am Anblick von Blut und Tod. Die Chance, dass {PAWN_pronoun} eine Prügelei beginnt, ist viermal höher als normal.

Kind_0.Name: Freundlich
Kind_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} ist ein außergewöhnlich netter und großzügiger Mensch. {PAWN_pronoun} wird andere nur selten beleidigen und manchmal freundliche Worte äußern, um {PAWN_possessive}e Mitmenschen aufzuheitern. Außerdem wird {PAWN_pronoun} Menschen niemals nach ihrem Aussehen beurteilen. {PAWN_possessive}e Nettigkeit führt aber dazu, dass {PAWN_pronoun} sich eher den vorherrschenden Meinungen anpasst.

Psychopath_0.Name: Psychopath
Psychopath_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat kein Mitgefühl. Das Leid der anderen stört {PAWN_objective} überhaupt nicht. Es macht {PAWN_gender ? ihm : ihr} nichts aus, wenn andere geschlachtet, tot liegen gelassen, eingesperrt oder in die Sklaverei verkauft werden – es sei denn, es betrifft {PAWN_objective} selbst. {PAWN_pronoun} bekommt keinen Stimmungsbonus durch soziale Interaktionen.

Cannibal_0.Name: Kannibale
Cannibal_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} bekam beigebracht, dass es falsch und schrecklich ist, Menschenfleisch zu essen. Trotzdem hat {PAWN_pronoun} es einmal probiert․․․ und es hat {PAWN_gender ? ihm : ihr} geschmeckt.

Abrasive_0.Name: Aufreibend
Abrasive_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} sagt immer genau das, was {PAWN_pronoun} denkt, vor allem dann, wenn es {PAWN_objective} stört. Dieses Verhalten wird von anderen oft als unangenehm empfunden.

TooSmart_0.Name: Zu klug
TooSmart_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} ist schlauer als {PAWN_gender ? ihm : ihr} lieb ist. {PAWN_pronoun} lernt alles viel schneller als andere, kann aber auch ziemlich exzentrisch sein.

Brawler_0.Name: Raufbold
Brawler_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} liebt es, wenn Kämpfe nah und persönlich sind. {PAWN_possessive}e Genauigkeit im Nahkampf ist unübertroffen, aber {PAWN_pronoun} bekommt schlechte Laune, wenn {PAWN_pronoun} eine Fernkampfwaffe tragen muss.

Masochist_0.Name: Masochist
Masochist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} findet es erregend, verletzt zu werden. Die Gründe dafür kennt {PAWN_pronoun} nicht – {PAWN_pronoun} ist einfach anders gestrickt.

NightOwl_0.Name: Nachteule
NightOwl_0.Description:
{PAWN_nameDef} mag es, nachts wach zu sein und tagsüber zu schlafen.

{PAWN_possessive}e Stimmung verbessert sich, wenn {PAWN_pronoun} nachts (23 bis 6 Uhr) wach ist, aber verschlechtert sich, wenn {PAWN_pronoun} tagsüber (11 bis 18 Uhr) wach ist.

{PAWN_pronoun} bekommt keinen Stimmungsabzug, wenn {PAWN_pronoun} sich im Dunkeln aufhält.

Greedy_0.Name: Habgierig
Greedy_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} braucht einen wirklich imposanten Schlafraum. {PAWN_possessive}e Stimmung verschlechtert sich, wenn {PAWN_pronoun} nicht bekommt, was {PAWN_pronoun} will.

Jealous_0.Name: Neidisch
Jealous_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} fühlt sich beleidigt, wenn {PAWN_possessive} Schlafraum nicht so imposant ist wie der eines anderen. {PAWN_possessive}e Stimmung verschlechtert sich, wenn ein anderer Kolonist einen imposanteren Schlafraum hat.

Ascetic_0.Name: Asket
Ascetic_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} verzichtet auf körperliche Annehmlichkeiten und Vergnügen zugunsten eines einfachen, reinen Lebensstils. {PAWN_pronoun} bekommt schlechte Laune, wenn {PAWN_possessive} Schlafraum zu imposant ist. Außerdem verabscheut {PAWN_pronoun} ausgefallenes Essen und isst am liebsten roh. {PAWN_pronoun} beurteilt andere nie nach ihrem Aussehen.

Gay_0.Name: Homosexuell
Gay_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} fühlt sich sexuell zu Menschen {PAWN_possessive}es eigenen Geschlechts hingezogen.

Bisexual_0.Name: Bisexuell
Bisexual_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} fühlt sich sowohl zu Männern als auch Frauen sexuell hingezogen.

AnnoyingVoice_0.Name: Nervige Stimme
AnnoyingVoice_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat eine ausgesprochen schrille, nasale Stimme und neigt dazu, sich in lauten, unverständlichen Sätzen auszudrücken – sehr zum Leidwesen anderer.

CreepyBreathing_0.Name: Gruselige Atmung
CreepyBreathing_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} atmet schwer und ist ständig am Schwitzen. Andere Leute finden das unheimlich.

Pyromaniac_0.Name: Pyromane
Pyromaniac_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} liebt das Feuer. {PAWN_pronoun} wird nie ein Feuer löschen. Außerdem wird {PAWN_pronoun} gelegentlich zum Feuerteufel und willkürlich Brände entfachen. {PAWN_pronoun} fühlt sich in der Nähe von Flammen wohl und ist noch glücklicher, wenn {PAWN_pronoun} eine Brandwaffe besitzt.

Wimp_0.Name: Weichei
Wimp_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} ist schwach und feige. Schon der kleinste Schmerz wird {PAWN_objective} umhauen.

Nimble_0.Name: Geschickt
Nimble_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} verfügt über eine bemerkenswerte kinästhetische Intelligenz. {PAWN_pronoun} scheint Gefahren mit außergewöhnlicher Eleganz zu umtanzen.

FastLearner_0.Name: Schneller Lerner
FastLearner_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat eine Begabung fürs Lernen. {PAWN_pronoun} begreift Dinge viel schneller als andere.

SlowLearner_0.Name: Langsamer Lerner
SlowLearner_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} ist schwer von Begriff. {PAWN_pronoun} lernt viel langsamer als andere.

Undergrounder_0.Name: Stubenhocker
Undergrounder_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat kein Bedürfnis, nach draußen zu gehen oder im Hellen zu sein. {PAWN_pronoun} wird sich nie eingesperrt fühlen oder einen Lagerkoller bekommen, und stört sich nicht an der Dunkelheit. Allerdings bekommt {PAWN_nameDef} schlechte Laune, wenn {PAWN_pronoun} draußen ist.

Transhumanist_0.Name: Körpermodifizierer
Transhumanist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} fühlt sich durch {PAWN_possessive}en schwachen menschlichen Körper eingeschränkt. {PAWN_pronoun} träumt oft davon, mit künstlichen Körperteilen oder Xenogenetik verbessert zu werden.

BodyPurist_0.Name: Körperpurist
BodyPurist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} glaubt, dass der menschliche Körper aus gutem Grund begrenzt ist. Für {PAWN_objective} sind künstliche Körperteile und Xenogene unethisch und abstoßend.

DislikesMen_0.Name: Misandrist
DislikesMen_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat eine starke Abneigung gegen Männer und misstraut ihnen.

DislikesWomen_0.Name: Misogynist
DislikesWomen_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat eine starke Abneigung gegen Frauen und misstraut ihnen.

GreatMemory_0.Name: Gutes Gedächtnis
GreatMemory_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat ein fantastisches Gedächtnis für Details. {PAWN_pronoun} vergisst ungenutzte Fertigkeiten nur halb so schnell wie andere Menschen.

Tough_0.Name: Zäh
Tough_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat eine dicke Haut, zähes Fleisch und sehr stabile Knochen. {PAWN_pronoun} erleidet bei gleichvielen Schlägen deutlich weniger Schaden als andere und ist sehr schwer zu töten.

TorturedArtist_0.Name: Gequälter Künstler
TorturedArtist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} fühlt sich von anderen Menschen entfremdet und missverstanden. {PAWN_pronoun} hat einen ständigen Stimmungsmalus, aber es besteht eine 50%ige Chance, dass {PAWN_pronoun} nach einem Nervenzusammenbruch eine kreative Eingebung erhält.

Gourmand_0.Name: Vielfraß
Gourmand_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} denkt ständig ans Essen. {PAWN_pronoun} wird schnell hungrig und bekommt gelegentlich den Drang, sich mit Essen vollzustopfen, auch wenn {PAWN_pronoun} eigentlich gar keinen Hunger hat.

QuickSleeper_0.Name: Kurzschläfer
QuickSleeper_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} braucht nicht so viel Schlaf wie andere. {PAWN_pronoun} wird, egal ob im Bett oder auf dem Boden, in etwa zwei Drittel der üblichen Zeit ausgeruht sein.

SpeedOffset_-1.Name: Lahme Ente
SpeedOffset_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] fällt immer hinter der Gruppe zurück, wenn [PAWN_pronoun] irgendwo hingeht.

SpeedOffset_1.Name: Schneller Läufer
SpeedOffset_1.Description: [PAWN_name] ist gerne dort, wo [PAWN_pronoun] hingeht. [PAWN_pronoun] läuft schneller als die meisten anderen.

SpeedOffset_2.Name: Jogger
SpeedOffset_2.Description: [PAWN_name] läuft immer, als hätte [PAWN_pronoun] es eilig – so eilig, dass andere oft nicht mithalten können.

DrugDesire_2.Name: Drogen-Faszination
DrugDesire_2.Description: [PAWN_name] ist völlig fasziniert von chemischen Rauschmitteln. Der Konsum von Drogen sorgt für gute Laune, während ein Verzicht auf Drogen zunehmend zu Frustration und möglicherweise zu Drogenexzessen führt. [PAWN_pronoun] wird Richtlinien, die {PAWN_gender ? ihm : ihr} vorschreiben, keine Drogen zu nehmen, ignorieren und mehr konsumieren als ein normaler Mensch.

DrugDesire_1.Name: Drogen-Interesse
DrugDesire_1.Description: [PAWN_name] hat ein ungewöhnliches Interesse an chemischen Rauschmitteln. Der Konsum von Drogen sorgt für gute Laune, während ein Verzicht auf Drogen zunehmend zu Frustration und möglicherweise zu Drogenexzessen führt. [PAWN_pronoun] wird Richtlinien, die {PAWN_gender ? ihm : ihr} vorschreiben, keine Drogen zu nehmen, ignorieren und mehr konsumieren als ein normaler Mensch.

DrugDesire_-1.Name: Abstinenzler
DrugDesire_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] verabscheut den Gedanken, sich an chemischen Rauschmitteln zu erfreuen. [PAWN_pronoun] verzichtet strikt auf Alkohol und Drogen.

NaturalMood_2.Name: Frohnatur
NaturalMood_2.Description: [PAWN_name] ist von Natur aus positiv gestimmt, und zwar zu jeder Zeit, egal in welcher Situation.

NaturalMood_1.Name: Optimist
NaturalMood_1.Description: [PAWN_name] ist von Natur aus optimistisch. Es ist schwer, [PAWN_objective] zu entmutigen.

NaturalMood_-1.Name: Pessimist
NaturalMood_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] ist von Natur aus pessimistisch. [PAWN_pronoun] neigt dazu, eher die negativen Seiten des Lebens zu sehen.

NaturalMood_-2.Name: Depressiv
NaturalMood_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] ist dauernd unglücklich. Es fällt {PAWN_gender ? ihm : ihr} schwer, dauerhaft gute Laune zu haben, selbst wenn alles in Ordnung ist.

Nerves_2.Name: Eiserner Wille
Nerves_2.Description: Der Wille von [PAWN_name] ist ein eiserner Schild. [PAWN_pronoun] geht durch dick und dünn, wo andere schon längst zusammengebrochen wären.

Nerves_1.Name: Standhaft
Nerves_1.Description: [PAWN_name] besitzt große mentale Stärke und hält sogar Belastungen stand, an denen andere längst zerbrochen wären.

Nerves_-1.Name: Nervös
Nerves_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] neigt dazu, unter Stress zu zerbrechen.

Nerves_-2.Name: Flatterhaft
Nerves_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] ist ständig nervös. [PAWN_pronoun] kann beim geringsten Stress in sich zusammenbrechen.

Neurotic_1.Name: Neurotisch
Neurotic_1.Description: [PAWN_name] mag es, wenn alles erledigt ist. [PAWN_pronoun] arbeitet härter als die meisten anderen, um diesen Zustand zu erreichen, aber [PAWN_possessive]e schwachen Nerven können {PAWN_gender ? ihm : ihr} zum Verhängnis werden.

Neurotic_2.Name: Stark neurotisch
Neurotic_2.Description: [PAWN_name] ist ständig nervös angesichts der Dinge, die erledigt werden müssen. [PAWN_pronoun] wird extrem hart arbeiten, um diesen Zustand zu erreichen, aber [PAWN_possessive]e schwachen Nerven können {PAWN_gender ? ihm : ihr} jederzeit zum Verhängnis werden.

Industriousness_2.Name: Fleißig
Industriousness_2.Description: [PAWN_name] fällt es leicht, bei der Sache zu bleiben und sich zu konzentrieren. [PAWN_pronoun] erledigt Dinge sehr viel schneller als die meisten anderen.

Industriousness_1.Name: Hart arbeitend
Industriousness_1.Description: [PAWN_name] ist von Natur aus {PAWN_gender ? ein harter Arbeiter : eine harte Arbeiterin} und wird Aufgaben schneller als die meisten anderen erledigen.

Industriousness_-2.Name: Faul
Industriousness_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] liebt das Nichtstun und hasst alles, was produktiv ist. [PAWN_pronoun] bewegt sich langsam und lässt sich leicht ablenken.

PsychicSensitivity_2.Name: Mental hochsensibel
PsychicSensitivity_2.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s Psyche ist wie eine mentale Stimmgabel. [PAWN_pronoun] ist extrem empfänglich für übersinnliche Phänomene.

PsychicSensitivity_1.Name: Mental sensibel
PsychicSensitivity_1.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s Psyche ist ungewöhnlich empfänglich für übersinnliche Phänomene.

PsychicSensitivity_-1.Name: Mental abgestumpft
PsychicSensitivity_-1.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s Psyche ist nicht im Einklang mit anderen. [PAWN_pronoun] wird nicht so stark von übersinnlichen Phänomenen beeinflusst.

PsychicSensitivity_-2.Name: Mental taub
PsychicSensitivity_-2.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s Psyche arbeitet auf einer anderen Frequenz als alle anderen. [PAWN_pronoun] ist immun gegen übersinnliche Phänomene.

ShootingAccuracy_1.Name: Sorgfältiger Schütze
ShootingAccuracy_1.Description: [PAWN_name] lässt sich mehr Zeit beim Zielen. [PAWN_pronoun] schießt langsamer als andere, aber dafür genauer.

ShootingAccuracy_-1.Name: Schießwütig
ShootingAccuracy_-1.Description: Peng! Peng! Peng! [PAWN_name] fackelt nicht lange und drückt ab. [PAWN_pronoun] schießt schneller als andere, aber dafür ungenauer.

Beauty_2.Name: Wunderschön
Beauty_2.Description: [PAWN_name] ist außergewöhnlich schön, mit einer exotischen und doch vertrauten Gesichtsform und einem fesselnden Blick. Die Menschen fühlen sich zu {PAWN_gender ? ihm : ihr} hingezogen, noch bevor [PAWN_pronoun] den Mund aufmacht.

Beauty_1.Name: Hübsch
Beauty_1.Description: [PAWN_name] hat ein hübsches Gesicht, das die Menschen dazu veranlasst, [PAWN_objective] zu mögen.

Beauty_-1.Name: Hässlich
Beauty_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] ist nicht sonderlich schön, was einen subtilen negativen Einfluss auf andere hat.

Beauty_-2.Name: Extrem hässlich
Beauty_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] ist unglaublich hässlich. [PAWN_possessive] Gesicht erinnert an eine Mischung aus einer unbeholfenen Kinderzeichnung, einem in Formaldehyd eingelegten missgebildeten Fötus und moderner Kunst. Es kostet große Überwindung, {PAWN_gender ? ihm : ihr} bei einem Gespräch ins Gesicht zu schauen.

Immunity_1.Name: Super-immun
Immunity_1.Description: [PAWN_name] hat von Natur aus ein starkes Immunsystem. [PAWN_pronoun] wird viel schneller immun als ein normaler Mensch und kann Krankheiten überleben, die andere töten würden.

Immunity_-1.Name: Kränklich
Immunity_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] hat ein schwaches Immunsystem. [PAWN_pronoun] wird häufiger krank als üblich und muss sich regelmäßig mit Krankheiten auseinandersetzen, an denen niemand sonst in der Kolonie erkrankt ist.

Delicate_0.Name: Fragil
Delicate_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat eine dünne Haut und schwache Knochen. {PAWN_pronoun} erleidet bei gleichvielen Schlägen mehr Schaden als andere.

Recluse_0.Name: Einsiedler
Recluse_0.Description: Je weniger Leute in der Fraktion sind, desto glücklicher ist {PAWN_nameDef}. Am liebsten ist {PAWN_pronoun} allein.

PerfectMemory_0.Name: Perfektes Gedächtnis
PerfectMemory_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat ein ausgezeichnetes Gedächtnis, sowohl was das Merken von Informationen als auch das Muskelgedächtnis betrifft. {PAWN_pronoun} wird nie vergessen, was {PAWN_pronoun} gelernt hat.

Occultist_0.Name: Okkultist
Occultist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat ein tiefes Verständnis für die verworrenen Muster der dunklen übersinnlichen Energie. {PAWN_pronoun} kann unnatürliche Entitäten schneller studieren als andere. {PAWN_pronoun} gibt dieses unmenschliche Wissen auch regelmäßig an andere weiter, wenn {PAWN_pronoun} die Gelegenheit dazu hat.

Joyous_0.Name: Fröhlich
Joyous_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat die Fähigkeit, jedem ein besseres Gefühl zu geben und ihn zu inspirieren, sein Bestes zu geben.

BodyMastery_0.Name: Körperbeherrschung
BodyMastery_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat keine Grundbedürfnisse wie Essen, Schlafen oder Komfort. {PAWN_possessive} Körper wird von einem unbekannten Mechanismus angetrieben, der {PAWN_possessive}e Augen völlig weiß werden lässt.

Disturbing_0.Name: Verstörend
Disturbing_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} ist ein seltsamer Mensch, der von abscheulichen Ideen besessen zu sein scheint. Ein Gespräch mit {PAWN_gender ? ihm : ihr} ist oft beunruhigend.

VoidFascination_0.Name: Leere-Faszination
VoidFascination_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} ist auf seltsame Weise von unnatürlichen Entitäten fasziniert und lässt sich leicht von ihnen in den Bann ziehen.

Gossip_0.Name: Klatsch und Tratsch
Gossip_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} kann einfach kein Geheimnis für sich behalten.

Trustworthy_0.Name: Vertrauenswürdig
Trustworthy_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} ist jemand, dem du deine intimsten Gedanken anvertrauen kannst. Wenn du {PAWN_objective} bittest, etwas für {PAWN_objective}selbst zu behalten, wird {PAWN_pronoun} es tun.

Manipulative_0.Name: Manipulativ
Manipulative_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} ist sozial manipulativ. {PAWN_pronoun} redet nicht immer schlecht über Leute, aber wenn {PAWN_pronoun} jemanden nicht mag, versucht {PAWN_pronoun}, den Rest der Kolonie gegen ihn aufzubringen.

Peacemaker_0.Name: Friedensstifter
Peacemaker_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} kann es einfach nicht leiden, wenn andere Leute kämpfen. {PAWN_pronoun} wird immer versuchen, andere zu überreden, ihre Differenzen beizulegen...

Gushing_0.Name: Sprudelnd
Gushing_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat kein besonderes Problem damit, die Geheimnisse anderer Leute zu bewahren, kann aber nicht darüber hinweghelfen, seine eigenen mit {PAWN_possessive} zu teilen.

CompulsiveLiar_0.Name: Zwanghafter Lügner
CompulsiveLiar_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hat eine schwierige Beziehung zur Wahrheit. Dies führt dazu, dass {PAWN_objective} auch zu anderen Kolonisten eine schwierige Beziehung hat.

AM_Ahimsa_0.Name: Vow of nonviolence
AM_Ahimsa_0.Description: A strict principle of nonviolence which applies to all living things.

RimScent_Anosmic_0.Name: Anosmic
RimScent_Anosmic_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has no sense of smell. While {PAWN_pronoun} cannot enjoy pleasant aromas, {PAWN_pronoun} is also completely immune to foul odors, smoke, and biological stenches.

RimScent_KeenNose_0.Name: Keen nose
RimScent_KeenNose_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} possesses an unnaturally sharp sense of smell. {PAWN_pronoun} is twice as sensitive to all smells.

RimScent_Dysosmic_0.Name: Dysosmic
RimScent_Dysosmic_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s olfactory system is wired backwards. {PAWN_pronoun} finds the smell of rot, filth, or smoke strangely alluring, while fresh rain or clean air makes {PAWN_objective} feel uneasy.

ST_Manipulative_0.Name: Manipulative
ST_Manipulative_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is good at getting {PAWN_possessive} way. Be it love bombing or gaslighting, {PAWN_possessive} victims rarely notice what’s truly going on.

ST_Naive_0.Name: Naive
ST_Naive_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} was taught everyone is good and kind. Maybe one day {PAWN_pronoun} will learn the lesson the hard way.

ST_Narcissist_0.Name: Vain
ST_Narcissist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes in pretty privilege. {PAWN_pronoun} is desperate to achieve flawless beauty by any means.

ST_HealthNut_0.Name: Health nut
ST_HealthNut_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}’s body is a temple, {PAWN_pronoun} only eats food to survive. {PAWN_pronoun} is here for a long time, not a good time.

ST_Emotional_0.Name: Emotional
ST_Emotional_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} feels {PAWN_possessive} emotions more profoundly and experiences greater mood swings. {PAWN_pronoun} often cries to release any frustration.

ST_Paranoid_0.Name: Paranoid
ST_Paranoid_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes good luck is an illusion and bad things are bound to happen. {PAWN_pronoun} is always ready for the worst case scenario.

ST_Goofball_0.Name: Goofball
ST_Goofball_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} acts funny in the day-to-day life. {PAWN_possessive} silly nature often amuses others.

ST_Loyal_0.Name: Loyal
ST_Loyal_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is never gonna give you up.

ST_PartyAnimal_0.Name: Party animal
ST_PartyAnimal_0.Description: For {PAWN_nameDef}, every season is party season!

ST_Insane_0.Name: Insane
ST_Insane_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} always seem out of place. No one knows what’s going on in {PAWN_possessive} head, not even {PAWN_objective}self.

ST_Proper_0.Name: Proper
ST_Proper_0.Description: Follow the dress code, say the right word. {PAWN_nameDef} has immaculate manners that navigate {PAWN_objective} through every social occasion.

ST_Grumpy_0.Name: Grumpy
ST_Grumpy_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} always seems annoyed, especially on a Monday. Others around {PAWN_objective} are constantly afraid to trigger {PAWN_possessive} grumbles.

ST_Shy_0.Name: Shy
ST_Shy_0.Description:
{PAWN_nameDef} struggles to socialise with other people, {PAWN_pronoun} especially cherish it while being on the receiving end of kindness.

Over the time, {PAWN_nameDef} have learned to spend more time on organising and introspecting {PAWN_objective}self.

ST_Materialistic_0.Name: Materialistic
ST_Materialistic_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} likes buying and bragging about {PAWN_possessive} new possessions.

ST_Vegan_0.Name: Vegan
ST_Vegan_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} avoids eating meat. {PAWN_pronoun} believes animals should not be treated as commodities and knows how to use plants to make delicious meals.

ST_Devout_0.Name: Devout
ST_Devout_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} devotes {PAWN_possessive} body and soul to what {PAWN_pronoun} believes. Somehow, {PAWN_possessive} prayers get answered.

ST_Procrastinator_0.Name: Procrastinator
ST_Procrastinator_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} likes to put things off until the last minute. {PAWN_pronoun} still manages to get those tasks done but the results are usually lacklustre.

ST_NonCommital_0.Name: Non-committal
ST_NonCommital_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} becomes tense after a while in the same job or relationship. {PAWN_possessive} fear of commitment facilitates change.

ST_HighMaintenance_0.Name: High maintenance
ST_HighMaintenance_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} can feel a pea under twenty mattresses while sleeping. {PAWN_pronoun} is born blue blood with expensive taste and trivial problems.

ST_FamilyOriented_0.Name: Family oriented
ST_FamilyOriented_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} want big families and enjoy being surrounded by children. {PAWN_pronoun} will make an excellent parent!

ST_SteadyHands_0.Name: Steady hands
ST_SteadyHands_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a pair of steady hands that never shakes or even trembles under pressure.

ST_Daredevil_0.Name: Daredevil
ST_Daredevil_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} enjoys chaos and takes the extreme side in life. {PAWN_pronoun} can’t quit the adrenaline rush from being reckless.

ST_Chatterbox_0.Name: Chatterbox
ST_Chatterbox_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} likes to talk and {PAWN_pronoun} sure talks a lot. People around {PAWN_objective} have started to develop immunity to whatever {PAWN_pronoun} says.

ST_Bookworm_0.Name: Bookworm
ST_Bookworm_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a deep love for reading. {PAWN_pronoun} reads fast and enjoys expanding {PAWN_possessive} knowledge this way.

ST_Handy_0.Name: Handy
ST_Handy_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} likes to get on with {PAWN_possessive} hands and tinkers around. {PAWN_pronoun} has the natural aptitude of handling those tiny precision components.

ST_Virtuoso_0.Name: Virtuoso
ST_Virtuoso_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a natural gift with musical and instruments. It is as if the music {PAWN_pronoun} plays lingered in the air.

ST_TechWhiz_0.Name: Tech whiz
ST_TechWhiz_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is brilliant with computers and technology. {PAWN_pronoun} can hack into other people’s data and security systems with ease.

ST_Gambler_0.Name: Gambler
ST_Gambler_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes in {PAWN_possessive} own luck. Despite the crippling addiction, {PAWN_possessive} luck certainly tips in a different direction on the battlefield.

ST_Childish_0.Name: Childish
ST_Childish_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} never lost that childlike wonder. {PAWN_pronoun} sees things through the eyes of a child and need to be constantly entertained.

ST_Nosy_0.Name: Nosy
ST_Nosy_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} ignores others' boundaries and likes pressing for more information, this often rubs people the wrong way.

ST_HugePower_0.Name: Huge power
ST_HugePower_0.Description:
{PAWN_nameDef} is noted for {PAWN_possessive} incredible strength. {PAWN_pronoun}'s naturally strong without the need to frequent the gym.

However, delicate tasks like medical operations pose a huge challenge, as the sheer force of {PAWN_possessive} grip hinders any precision.

ST_Observant_0.Name: Observant
ST_Observant_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a pair of keen eyes that scans through every detail and miss no strange things. {PAWN_pronoun} can even spot distant ships while stargazing through a telescope.

ST_Zen_0.Name: Zen
ST_Zen_0.Description:
{PAWN_nameDef} takes time to discover beauty in everything. {PAWN_pronoun} sees the world in a grain of sand.

To {PAWN_objective}, actively sabotaging life is a despicable act.

VAEI_Inhumanized_0.Name: Inhumanized
VAEI_Inhumanized_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s mind is dominated by the psychic patterns of the void. They are completely disconnected from human concerns of family, friendship, and love. Their experience of reality is distant and muted, guided by the psychic rhythm of a dark hyperintelligence.

VAEI_VoidTouched_0.Name: Void touched
VAEI_VoidTouched_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has seen the depths of the void and drank from its essence. It lives inside them still, guiding their actions and twisting their flesh. It has turned their hair brittle and white. They no longer need sleep or comfort. The void provides for them.

VAEI_Germaphobe_0.Name: Germaphobe
VAEI_Germaphobe_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is terrified of germs and contamination, leading to excessively slow and meticulous cleaning, but due to the careful nature will never contract flu, malaria, or plague.

VAEI_Noncommittal_0.Name: Noncommittal
VAEI_Noncommittal_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is desperately afraid of commitment. {PAWN_pronoun} will actively refuse any attachment to others, and will never form any new relationships.

VAEI_Unstable_0.Name: Impulsive
VAEI_Unstable_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s emotional foundation is fragile, making {PAWN_objective} significantly more prone to crumbling under stress. {PAWN_pronoun} struggle to handle pressure, which often leads to breakdowns in challenging situations.

VAEI_Distractable_0.Name: Distractable
VAEI_Distractable_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hyperfocuses on certain things when {PAWN_pronoun} feel like it, but most of the time {PAWN_pronoun} will struggle to concentrate on {PAWN_possessive} task, severely affecting {PAWN_possessive} work speed.

VAEI_MoodSwings_0.Name: Mood swings
VAEI_MoodSwings_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} suffers from severe mood swings that can last anything between a day and a quadrum. One day {PAWN_pronoun} might be extremely happy, whilst the next day - extremely sad.

VFEP_WarcasketTrait_0.Name: Warcasket
VFEP_WarcasketTrait_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is entombed in a warcasket. No amount of pain will have an effect on them, and they can never go into a pain shock or drop unconscious due to pain. Because of how bulky the armor is and how much energy it takes to use it, {PAWN_nameDef} is not capable of doing any work.

VFEP_Shellcasket_0.Name: Shellcasket
VFEP_Shellcasket_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} was entombed in a warcasket, and then brutally pulled out of one. The neural and nerve damage from being unplugged is so severe that {PAWN_nameDef} is in constant, agonizing pain and can barely assemble {PAWN_possessive} thoughts. Only installing {PAWN_nameDef} back in a warcasket can cure the symptoms.

VME_Elder_0.Name: Elder
VME_Elder_0.Description: Either the body or mind of {PAWN_nameDef} is one of insight and experience. While some find them old fashioned, others will respect their guidance.
VME_Elder_0.ModSource: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures

VPE_Thrall_0.Name: Thrall
VPE_Thrall_0.Description: Psychic enthrallment caused by incredibly strong mental influence. Thralls don't need to sleep or have recreation, but are unable to do skilled work and engage in social interactions.

VRE_Flirty_0.Name: Flirty
VRE_Flirty_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is always ready with a flirtatious comment or a playful compliment, lifting the spirits of those around {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} has a knack for making others feel special and desired, however this may sometimes lead to complicated situations when {PAWN_possessive} playful intentions are misinterpreted.

VRE_Distressed_0.Name: Distressed
VRE_Distressed_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is exceptionally empathetic and sensitive to the suffering of others. Whenever {PAWN_pronoun} witnesses pain or hardship, it deeply affects {PAWN_objective}, resulting in memories of these events haunting {PAWN_nameDef} for a much longer time.

SEX_Solitary_0.Name: Solitary
SEX_Solitary_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is comfortable with isolation. {PAWN_pronoun} does not have a need for intimacy.

SEX_Affectionate_0.Name: Affectionate
SEX_Affectionate_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is quite the social butterfly. {PAWN_pronoun} has an increased need for intimacy.

Isekai_Protagonist_0.Name: Protagonist
Isekai_Protagonist_0.Description:
This individual is the Protagonist — chosen by fate itself. They gain experience at an extraordinary rate and grow faster than anyone else.

• x10 XP multiplier
• Cannot have: Antagonist, Regressor, Summoned Hero

Isekai_Antagonist_0.Name: Antagonist
Isekai_Antagonist_0.Description:
This individual walks the path of the Antagonist — feared and reviled. They grow powerful through conflict, gaining massive combat bonuses, but their very presence unsettles others.

• x8 XP multiplier
• +25% melee damage
• +10% move speed
• -25% social impact
• -25 opinion from all other pawns
• Cannot have: Protagonist, Summoned Hero

Isekai_Reincarnated_0.Name: Reincarnated
Isekai_Reincarnated_0.Description:
This individual has been reincarnated — reborn into a new life with memories of the old. Their level and stats were reset, but they retained their constellation progress and earned powerful growth bonuses.

• Resets level to 1 and all stats to base (New Game+)
• x5 XP multiplier
• +10 bonus star points
• +1 star point every 3 levels instead of 5
• Constellation tree progress preserved
• Cannot have: Protagonist, Antagonist, Hollow Core

Isekai_Regressor_0.Name: Regressor
Isekai_Regressor_0.Description:
This individual has regressed — returned to the past with fragments of future knowledge. They level faster and can freely readapt their constellation at any time.

• x4 XP multiplier
• Free constellation respec (always)
• Cannot have: Protagonist

Isekai_SummonedHero_0.Name: Summoned hero
Isekai_SummonedHero_0.Description:
This individual was summoned from another world as a hero. They gain power rapidly and are mentally resilient, but the displacement from their home world weighs on them.

• x3 XP multiplier
• +1 bonus stat point per level
• Highly resistant to mental breaks
• +25% social impact
• -8 mood (displaced from home)
• Cannot have: Protagonist, Antagonist

Isekai_NaturalTalent_0.Name: Natural talent
Isekai_NaturalTalent_0.Description:
Born with exceptional latent potential. This individual earns bonus star points as they level, allowing them to unlock more constellation nodes.

• +1 bonus star point every 5 levels (2 instead of 1)

Isekai_Prodigy_0.Name: Prodigy
Isekai_Prodigy_0.Description:
A genius who absorbs knowledge at an astonishing rate. Their mind operates on another level entirely.

• x2 XP multiplier
• +50% research speed

Isekai_LateBloomer_0.Name: Late bloomer
Isekai_LateBloomer_0.Description:
Starts slow but becomes unstoppable. XP gain scales dramatically with level — weak early, godlike late.

• Level 1-10: x0.5 XP
• Level 11-25: x1.0 XP
• Level 26-50: x1.5 XP
• Level 51-100: x2.0 XP
• Level 101+: x3.0 XP

Isekai_QuickLearner_0.Name: Quick learner
Isekai_QuickLearner_0.Description:
Grows and gains power faster than most. A reliable, steady advantage in all situations.

• x1.5 XP multiplier

Isekai_SlowGrind_0.Name: Slow grind
Isekai_SlowGrind_0.Description:
Levels slowly but squeezes maximum potential from every level gained. Quality over speed.

• x0.5 XP multiplier
• +2 bonus stat points per level

Isekai_PowerSpike_0.Name: Power spike
Isekai_PowerSpike_0.Description:
Experiences sudden surges of power at regular intervals, gaining massive stat boosts at milestone levels.

• +5 bonus stat points every 10 levels

Isekai_AwakenedPotential_0.Name: Awakened potential
Isekai_AwakenedPotential_0.Description:
Dormant power awakens at level 25, dramatically increasing all stat effectiveness. Before awakening, the pawn is unremarkable.

• Below level 25: -10% all stats
• Level 25+: +50% all stat effectiveness

Isekai_Genius_0.Name: Genius
Isekai_Genius_0.Description:
A towering intellect in a mediocre body. Mental stats grow twice as fast, but physical stats grow at half speed.

• INT and WIS stat gains doubled
• STR and VIT stat gains halved

Isekai_BattleManiac_0.Name: Battle maniac
Isekai_BattleManiac_0.Description:
Lives only for battle. Gains massively increased combat XP but is nearly incapable of learning from peaceful activities.

• x3 combat XP (damage, kills)
• x0.1 work/social XP
• +15% melee dodge chance

Isekai_BerserkerBlood_0.Name: Berserker blood
Isekai_BerserkerBlood_0.Description:
When wounded, primal rage surges through their veins. The more they bleed, the harder they fight.

• Below 50% HP: +30% melee damage, +15% move speed
• Below 25% HP: +60% melee damage, +30% move speed
• -10% mental break threshold (easier to break)

Isekai_IronWill_0.Name: Iron will
Isekai_IronWill_0.Description:
An unbreakable mind forged through hardship. Nearly immune to mental breaks and pain, but emotionally distant.

• -25% mental break threshold
• +30% pain shock threshold
• -20% social impact

Isekai_GlassCannon_0.Name: Glass cannon
Isekai_GlassCannon_0.Description:
Devastatingly powerful but dangerously fragile. Every attack hits like a truck, but they can't take a hit.

• +50% melee damage
• +30% ranged combat effectiveness
• VIT effectiveness halved

Isekai_Fortress_0.Name: Fortress
Isekai_Fortress_0.Description:
An immovable defensive bastion. Incredibly tough and resistant to damage, but slow and lacks offensive punch.

• +20% natural armor (all types)
• -25% move speed
• -20% melee damage

Isekai_ShadowStep_0.Name: Shadow step
Isekai_ShadowStep_0.Description:
Moves like a shadow, nearly impossible to pin down. Exceptional evasion and speed, but lacks the constitution to take hits.

• +25% move speed
• +20% melee dodge chance
• -10% melee damage

Isekai_PredatorInstinct_0.Name: Predator's instinct
Isekai_PredatorInstinct_0.Description:
Possesses primal hunting instincts — an innate sense for combat and danger that enhances all fighting capabilities.

• +15% melee hit chance
• +15% shooting accuracy
• -15% trap spring chance

Isekai_Undying_0.Name: Undying
Isekai_Undying_0.Description:
Fate refuses to let this individual die. When struck by a killing blow, they miraculously survive — but the experience leaves a permanent mark on their psyche.

• Cheat death: Survive lethal damage once every 3 days
• +20% pain shock threshold
• -5 mood (touched by death) after triggering

Isekai_Mighty_0.Name: Mighty
Isekai_Mighty_0.Description:
Blessed with exceptional physical strength but lacks finesse.

• STR stat effectiveness x1.5
• DEX stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_Agile_0.Name: Agile
Isekai_Agile_0.Description:
Graceful and quick with exceptional reflexes, but physically weaker.

• DEX stat effectiveness x1.5
• STR stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_Resilient_0.Name: Resilient
Isekai_Resilient_0.Description:
An iron constitution that shrugs off what would fell others, but spiritually dulled.

• VIT stat effectiveness x1.5
• WIS stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_Brilliant_0.Name: Brilliant
Isekai_Brilliant_0.Description:
A sharp analytical mind that processes information at incredible speeds, but socially awkward.

• INT stat effectiveness x1.5
• CHA stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_Enlightened_0.Name: Enlightened
Isekai_Enlightened_0.Description:
Deeply perceptive and spiritually attuned. Great wisdom comes at the cost of physical endurance.

• WIS stat effectiveness x1.5
• VIT stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_SilverTongue_0.Name: Silver tongue
Isekai_SilverTongue_0.Description:
A natural-born leader and diplomat whose words carry weight, but lacks analytical depth.

• CHA stat effectiveness x1.5
• INT stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_MerchantEye_0.Name: Merchant's eye
Isekai_MerchantEye_0.Description:
An innate sense for value and negotiation. Always gets the best deals.

• +25% trade price improvement
• +20% negotiation ability

Isekai_CraftsmanSoul_0.Name: Craftsman's soul
Isekai_CraftsmanSoul_0.Description:
A born artisan with an instinctive understanding of materials and construction. Everything they make is a cut above.

• +25% work speed (all types)
• +1 crafting quality tier chance

Isekai_BeastWhisperer_0.Name: Beast whisperer
Isekai_BeastWhisperer_0.Description:
Has an uncanny bond with animals. Creatures of all kinds are drawn to this individual, making taming and training trivially easy.

• +40% tame animal chance
• +30% train animal chance
• +25% animal gather yield
• Animals won't attack unprovoked

Isekai_HealerTouch_0.Name: Healer's touch
Isekai_HealerTouch_0.Description:
Healing flows through their hands like magic. Their medical skills far exceed what training alone could explain.

• +30% medical tend quality
• +25% surgery success chance
• +20% immunity gain speed

Isekai_Lucky_0.Name: Lucky
Isekai_Lucky_0.Description:
Fortune favors them endlessly. Good things just seem to happen around this individual.

• +15% surgery success
• +10% shooting accuracy
• +10% trade prices
• +5 mood (feeling lucky)

Isekai_CursedLuck_0.Name: Cursed luck
Isekai_CursedLuck_0.Description:
Terrible luck plagues them, yet somehow they thrive in adversity. Misfortune strengthens them in mysterious ways.

• x2 XP multiplier
• -15% surgery success
• -10% trade prices
• +20% melee damage
• -5 mood (cursed by fate)

Isekai_HollowCore_0.Name: Hollow core
Isekai_HollowCore_0.Description:
Their spiritual core is shattered — they can channel raw power but cannot form the connections needed for constellation skills.

• x3 XP multiplier
• Cannot unlock any constellation nodes
• No star points gained

Isekai_FragileVessel_0.Name: Fragile vessel
Isekai_FragileVessel_0.Description:
Their body wasn't built to contain this much power. They grow rapidly but their physical form deteriorates under the strain.

• x2.5 XP multiplier
• -50% max health
• VIT effectiveness halved

Isekai_EchoOfDefeat_0.Name: Echo of defeat
Isekai_EchoOfDefeat_0.Description:
Grows stronger through failure. Each defeat fuels their determination to improve.

• Permanent +10% XP bonus
• x2 XP for 3 days after being downed
• -5% melee damage

Isekai_SealedPower_0.Name: Sealed power
Isekai_SealedPower_0.Description:
Immense power sealed away, waiting to be unleashed. Weak and stunted until the seal breaks at level 25, then gains an explosive power surge.

• Before level 25: -30% all stats, no star points
• At level 25: Seal breaks!
• After level 25: Double stat points per level (up to +2 bonus), +2 star points per 5 levels

Isekai_Rank_F_0.Name: Rank F
Isekai_Rank_F_0.Description: This individual is recognized as an F-Rank - the weakest classification. Others look down on them with pity or contempt, and their presence commands no respect.

Isekai_Rank_E_0.Name: Rank E
Isekai_Rank_E_0.Description: This individual is classified as E-Rank - below average but not completely worthless. They are often overlooked and struggle to gain recognition.

Isekai_Rank_D_0.Name: Rank D
Isekai_Rank_D_0.Description: This individual holds a D-Rank classification - thoroughly average. They neither stand out nor fall behind, blending into the crowd.

Isekai_Rank_C_0.Name: Rank C
Isekai_Rank_C_0.Description: This individual is recognized as C-Rank - a competent person above the common masses. They command modest respect and are seen as reliable.

Isekai_Rank_B_0.Name: Rank B
Isekai_Rank_B_0.Description: This individual has achieved B-Rank status - a skilled veteran worthy of respect. Their reputation precedes them, and others treat them with deference.

Isekai_Rank_A_0.Name: Rank A
Isekai_Rank_A_0.Description: This individual is an A-Rank elite - among the finest in existence. Their very presence commands attention, and they exude an aura of power and authority that few can match.

Isekai_Rank_S_0.Name: Rank S
Isekai_Rank_S_0.Description: This individual holds the legendary S-Rank - a hero of incredible power. Their name is spoken with reverence, and their mere glance can silence a room. Others feel humbled in their presence.

Isekai_Rank_SS_0.Name: Rank SS
Isekai_Rank_SS_0.Description: This individual has transcended to SS-Rank - a demigod walking among mortals. Their power is the stuff of legends, and entire nations would pay any price to secure their loyalty. They radiate an otherworldly magnificence.

Isekai_Rank_SSS_0.Name: Rank SSS
Isekai_Rank_SSS_0.Description: This individual has achieved the impossible - SSS-Rank, the absolute apex of existence. They are a god among mortals, their power beyond comprehension. Kingdoms would fall to possess them, and their very existence reshapes the world around them.

PE_LowTechProficiency_0.Name: Low-tech proficient
PE_LowTechProficiency_0.Description: This person is proficient with low-tech equipment.

PE_FirearmProficiency_0.Name: Firearm proficient
PE_FirearmProficiency_0.Description: This person is proficient with firearm equipment.

PE_HighTechProficiency_0.Name: High-tech proficient
PE_HighTechProficiency_0.Description: This person is proficient with high-tech equipment.

PE_AnimalRidingProficiency_0.Name: Animal riding
PE_AnimalRidingProficiency_0.Description: This person is proficient with animal riding.

PE_AutomobileDrivingProficiency_0.Name: Automobile driving
PE_AutomobileDrivingProficiency_0.Description: This person is proficient with automobile driving.

PE_AerialPilotingProficiency_0.Name: Aerial piloting
PE_AerialPilotingProficiency_0.Description: This person is proficient with aerial piloting.

PE_OrbitalPilotingProficiency_0.Name: Orbital piloting
PE_OrbitalPilotingProficiency_0.Description: This person is proficient with orbital piloting.

PE_MuteProficiency_0.Name: Mute
PE_MuteProficiency_0.Description: This person has no understanding of language.

PE_BasicSpeechProficiency_0.Name: Basic speech
PE_BasicSpeechProficiency_0.Description: This person has a basic understanding of language and can speak it with half effectiveness.

PE_FluentSpeechProficiency_0.Name: Fluent speech
PE_FluentSpeechProficiency_0.Description: This person has a complete understanding of language and can speak it with full effectiveness.

AG_Beauty_2.Name: Angelic beauty
AG_Beauty_2.Description: [PAWN_name] possesses an unnatural, almost pristine beauty that makes [PAWN_objective] stand out among others of [PAWN_possessive] kind.

AG_Beauty_-2.Name: Repulsive
AG_Beauty_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] is so unfathomably ugly and grotesque that merely looking at [PAWN_objective] is enough to make other people nauseous.

Hygienic_2.Name: Mysophobie
Hygienic_2.Description: [PAWN_name] hat eine krankhafte Angst vor Keimen und wäscht sich viel häufiger als andere.

Hygienic_1.Name: Hygienisch
Hygienic_1.Description: [PAWN_name] ist sehr hygienisch und wäscht sich öfters.

Hygienic_-1.Name: Unhygienisch
Hygienic_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] ist sehr unhygienisch und wird sich seltener waschen.

Hygienic_-2.Name: Schmutzfink
Hygienic_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] hat ein sehr geringes Sauberkeitsbedürfnis und wäscht sich nur, wenn es unbedingt nötig ist.

VQE_IdealPatient_0.Name: Ideal patient
VQE_IdealPatient_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body accepts archite alterations with unnatural ease. {PAWN_pronoun} will never suffer rejections during the injection process.

Isekai_Rank_Nation_0.Name: Rank Nation
Isekai_Rank_Nation_0.Description: This individual is no longer measured against people. Nations weigh them against armies, and treaties are written with them in mind. Their name is spoken in war rooms a continent away, and every guild on the Rim has a standing file on where they were last seen.

Isekai_Title_Sword_0.Name: Retired title
Isekai_Title_Sword_0.Description: A title from an earlier version of this mod. It is replaced automatically the first time this save is loaded.

Isekai_Title_Sword_1.Name: Sword Disciple
Isekai_Title_Sword_1.Description:
Everything spent on the arm that swings. Strength with an edge put on it, and no second answer to anything.

The blade still argues back. They win more of those arguments than they lose now, which is new.

No one has heard of them yet, and that is fair enough.

+5% move speed and melee dodge.

Isekai_Title_Sword_2.Name: Sword Expert
Isekai_Title_Sword_2.Description:
Everything spent on the arm that swings. Strength with an edge put on it, and no second answer to anything.

The blade still argues back. They win more of those arguments than they lose now, which is new.

The one people send for when it matters locally.

+9% move speed and melee dodge.

Isekai_Title_Sword_3.Name: Sword Saint
Isekai_Title_Sword_3.Description:
Everything spent on the arm that swings. Strength with an edge put on it, and no second answer to anything.

Armour is a suggestion. What they hit stops being a problem in one motion, and anyone who has seen it knows to stand clear.

The name travels now. It gets repeated by people who have never met them.

Fire finds nothing to hold on them. Flame that touches this one gutters out on its own, and they carry on with whatever they were doing rather than break off to beat at themselves. Heat still burns; they simply do not catch.

+13% move speed and melee dodge.

Isekai_Title_Sword_4.Name: Sword King
Isekai_Title_Sword_4.Description:
Everything spent on the arm that swings. Strength with an edge put on it, and no second answer to anything.

Armour is a suggestion. What they hit stops being a problem in one motion, and anyone who has seen it knows to stand clear.

Spoken of well beyond here, and not always kindly by those walking the same road.

Fire finds nothing to hold on them. Flame that touches this one gutters out on its own, and they carry on with whatever they were doing rather than break off to beat at themselves. Heat still burns; they simply do not catch.

+17% move speed and melee dodge.

Isekai_Title_Sword_5.Name: Sword Emperor
Isekai_Title_Sword_5.Description:
Everything spent on the arm that swings. Strength with an edge put on it, and no second answer to anything.

Strength with no practical limit left. No guard holds, no weapon survives the parry, and nothing remains that a single swing does not settle.

A name people grow up hearing. Those below look up, and those in the same art cannot quite share a roof with them.

Fire finds nothing to hold on them. Flame that touches this one gutters out on its own, and they carry on with whatever they were doing rather than break off to beat at themselves. Heat still burns; they simply do not catch.

+21% move speed and melee dodge.

Isekai_Title_Sword_6.Name: Sword God
Isekai_Title_Sword_6.Description:
Everything spent on the arm that swings. Strength with an edge put on it, and no second answer to anything.

Strength with no practical limit left. No guard holds, no weapon survives the parry, and nothing remains that a single swing does not settle.

Children are told about people like this. There is no one left above to look up to, and no one in the same art who can stand near them without feeling it.

Fire finds nothing to hold on them. Flame that touches this one gutters out on its own, and they carry on with whatever they were doing rather than break off to beat at themselves. Heat still burns; they simply do not catch.

+25% move speed and melee dodge.

Isekai_Title_Archer_0.Name: Retired title
Isekai_Title_Archer_0.Description: A title from an earlier version of this mod. It is replaced automatically the first time this save is loaded.

Isekai_Title_Archer_1.Name: Archer Disciple
Isekai_Title_Archer_1.Description:
Everything spent on the hand that steadies. Distance is not a disadvantage to them, it is where they would rather the fight happened.

The shot lands more often than not, and the ones that miss still teach them something.

No one has heard of them yet, and that is fair enough.

-5% aiming time.

Isekai_Title_Archer_2.Name: Archer Expert
Isekai_Title_Archer_2.Description:
